scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run build --workspace=@workspace/api-server && node --enable-source-maps artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build --workspace=@workspace/api-server && node --enable-source-maps artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
